name: top-bar
title: Top bar
description: The 48px bar over every console page: breadcrumbs, each step back a link, the page itself in ink, a namespace in mono. Its crumbs are the breadcrumb.
use_for: Saying where you are and the way back, over every console page.
never: Repeating the page's title as a heading right under it
Actions that belong to the page: they go in the page's head
body:
`Breadcrumb` is shadcn's breadcrumb: pass `items` (`label`, `href`, `mono`), the last is the page. Give `as` your router
link (`NuxtLink`) to navigate without a reload.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
// The 48px bar over every console page (console2.css .v2-bar): sticky, a hairline under it, the page showing faintly
// through it (92% of the surface under an 8px blur), 12px text. Put a Breadcrumb in the default slot; `start` holds the
// phone's menu button, `end` what belongs to the whole console (setup progress, a loading mark), never the page's
// own actions.
</script>

<template>
  <header data-ds="top-bar" class="sticky top-0 z-10 flex h-bar shrink-0 items-center gap-2 border-b border-edge bg-bar px-4 text-meta leading-5 backdrop-blur-sm">
    <slot name="start" />
    <slot />
    <slot name="end" />
  </header>
</template>

examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Breadcrumb from '@/components/ui/Breadcrumb.vue'
import TopBar from '@/components/ui/TopBar.vue'
// The bar over every console page: where you are, each step back a link, the page in ink, a namespace in mono.
const crumbs = [{ label: 'Overview', href: '#' }, { label: 'Namespaces', href: '#' }, { label: 'contracts', mono: true }]
</script>

<template>
  <TopBar class="border border-edge">
    <Breadcrumb :items="crumbs" @navigate="(_, e) => e.preventDefault()" />
  </TopBar>
</template>
